details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: stack buffer overflow in xmlSnprintfElements()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-86140.patch: add bounds checks around the
       parenthesis writes in xmlSnprintfElements() in valid.c
     - CVE-2026-86140
   * SECURITY UPDATE: NULL pointer dereference in xmlRegNewParserCtxt() after
     a failed allocation
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-86141.patch: check the xmlStrdup() result in
       xmlRegNewParserCtxt() in xmlregexp.c so a failed allocation cannot
       leave a NULL parser cursor
     - CVE-2026-86141
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow in xmlXPtrEvalXPtrPart() on
     oversized xpointer() expressions
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-86142.patch: make xmlStrlen() in xmlstring.c
       saturate above INT_MAX and reject the saturated length in
       xmlXPtrEvalXPtrPart() in xpointer.c before sizing the buffer
     - CVE-2026-86142
   * SECURITY UPDATE: integer overflow before the output write callback
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-86143.patch: check for integer overflow before
       passing a buffer length to the write callback in xmlIO.c
     - CVE-2026-86143
   * SECURITY UPDATE: parse flags not propagated by xmlXIncludeProcess() and
     xmlXIncludeProcessTree()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-86144.patch: propagate the document parse
       flags in xmlXIncludeProcess() and xmlXIncludeProcessTree() in
       xinclude.c
     - CVE-2026-86144
